doc.exposure_position: Product's exposure position type (organic / ad / both, comma-separated).
doc.latest_ad_exposure_time: Latest ad exposure time (yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm); empty when no exposure.
doc.latest_ad_position: Latest ad exposure position text (e.g. "Page X, Pos Y/Z"); empty when no exposure.
doc.latest_organic_exposure_time: Latest organic exposure time (yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm); empty when no exposure.
doc.latest_organic_position: Latest organic exposure position text (e.g. "Page X, Pos Y/Z"); empty when no exposure.
doc.monthly_search_volume: Monthly search volume of this keyword.
doc.recommended_bid: Recommended CPC bid for this keyword (string, in USD).
doc.recommended_bid_range: Recommended CPC bid range for this keyword, e.g. "0.38-0.63".
